# conductorone_mcp_server (Resource)

MCP server resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) ID of the existing app that owns the MCP server.
- `display_name` (String) Admin-provided display name.
- `server_type` (String) Whether the server is hosted by C1 or is an external endpoint.

### Optional

- `data_sensitivity` (String) Data sensitivity classification.
- `description` (String) Admin-provided description.
- `external_config` (String, Sensitive) JSON configuration for an external server, excluding url. It contains exactly one auth configuration.
- `external_url` (String) HTTPS endpoint for an external MCP server. Changing it replaces the server.
- `hosted_catalog_id` (String) Catalog entry ID for a hosted MCP server. Changing it replaces the server.
- `hosted_config` (String, Sensitive) JSON configuration for a hosted server, excluding mcpServerCatalogId. It contains exactly one auth configuration.
- `require_tool_approval` (Boolean) Whether users must enable server tools. When omitted, the server inherits the tenant setting.
- `tool_prefix` (String) Optional prefix for tool names exposed by C1.

### Read-Only

- `connector_id` (String) Connector ID of the registered MCP server.
